entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-04-02
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Not showing subcommand help for "dotnet nuget add source --help" in 11.0 SDK #53673
  • `PackageReference` doesn't work when under `Condition` dependent on `Configuration` in a project referenced by another project with both being built with `dotnet build solution.sln` #53672

Closed

  • Microsoft.VisualStudio.JavaScript.Sdk Test Explorer broken integration with Vitest 4.1 #53606

Merged

  • Copy HotReload dll to intermediate to avoid duplicate identity in multi-client WASM #53656
